Hi Erin —

Following up from our billing hold notice: Finance is asking for your company’s sales tax exemption / resale certificate so we can clear two outstanding invoices (INV-7891, INV-7922) and apply the correct tax treatment going forward. To process quickly we need a PDF copy that includes:

- Purchaser legal name and address as shown on your W-9/registration
- State(s) covered by the certificate (OR, WA, etc.)
- Effective date and expiration (if any)
- Purchaser tax ID / WA UBI or state registration number (where required)
- Signature and printed name (digital signature ok)

If the certificate requires seller info to be filled, please include Redwood’s seller name and address: Redwood Inference, 1201 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103.

Please send to billing@redwood.com and copy me and Rishi so I can expedite release. I’ve also linked our HubSpot record here for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/98765

Thanks — a quick scan or a one-page PDF will do.

Best,

Erin —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. Monica from Billing is copied — a couple of follow-ups from our side before we can clear the hold:

1) Washington certificate looks good but is the WA document a general resale certificate or specific to “retail sales”? Our billing team needs to confirm the intended exemption type for cloud/SaaS transactions.
2) Some states require the seller’s name and address filled in on the purchaser certificate; could you confirm whether WestCoast is okay with us inserting Redwood Inference as the seller on the form (we can provide the exact seller block)?
3) If there’s an expiration date, please confirm; our system flags certificates without an explicit expiration.

If you can provide a version with seller info completed (or confirm in a reply that the attached docs are acceptable as-is for reseller exemption), Monica will validate and release the two invoices. I’ve attached a sample filled form (sample-fill.pdf) for reference — feel free to replicate.

Thanks again — want to get this resolved today if possible.

Best,
